title: Existence of a third left-derived value
statement: In Situation 05S8 [def-pur-saturated-triangulated-localization], let $(X,Y,Z,f,g,h)$ be a distinguished triangle [def-weil-triangulated-category]. If the denominator pro-diagrams at $X$ and $Y$ are essentially constant with some values [def-pc-essentially-constant-pro-diagram], then the denominator pro-diagram at $Z$ is essentially constant with some value. No choice of triangle maps or distinguished triangle of values is asserted.

proof.text: Extract the supplied values A and B from hX and hY. The comparison lemma supplies a candidate Y, denominator s and map r inducing bijections on all Hom-colimits.

MS1 gives an identity denominator at the third vertex. Right MS2 gives common predecessors of two denominators, and right MS3 equalizes two arrows, hence S/T.obj₃ is cofiltered. Apply the pro-criterion at s and r to the comparison bijections and keep its essential-constancy conclusion. Package Y as the third left-derived value.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 05SC, LF clause, reduced to its Hom-colimit comparison and criterion 05PY
